# Yasheng FRP (YSFRP) — Custom FRP, Fiberglass & Carbon Fiber OEM/ODM Manufacturer

> Dongguan Yasheng FRP Technology Co., Ltd. (brand: YSFRP) is a China-based OEM/ODM manufacturer of custom FRP (fiberglass), CFRP (carbon fiber) and composite enclosures, shells, housings and covers. Founded in 2015, operating a 7,000 m² factory in Dongguan, Guangdong, and shipping to 50+ countries. Pricing is quotation-based (no public price list); MOQ starts at 1 piece for prototypes.

Company: Dongguan Yasheng FRP Technology Co., Ltd.
Brand: YSFRP / Yasheng FRP
Founded: 2015 (10+ years of manufacturing experience)
Facility: 7,000 m² manufacturing plant in Dongguan, Guangdong, China
Certification: ISO 9001
Materials: FRP (fiberglass), CFRP (carbon fiber); foam sandwich construction available
Shipping: 50+ countries worldwide
Pricing: quotation-based — send drawings, 3D models or requirements; no fixed public prices
MOQ: 1 piece for prototypes
Quotation: returned within 24 hours of receiving drawings or requirements
Contact: WhatsApp / Tel +86 131 1312 5793 · serafinalin091@gmail.com · https://ysfrp.com/contact.html

## Product lines

- [FRP Radomes](https://ysfrp.com/products/radomes/): Custom fiberglass antenna covers and radomes for 5G, radar and satellite communications.
- [USV Hulls](https://ysfrp.com/products/equipment/usv-hull/): Custom fiberglass and carbon fiber unmanned surface vehicle hulls.
- [Equipment Enclosures](https://ysfrp.com/products/equipment/): Custom FRP industrial housings, cabinets and protective covers.
- [Automotive Shells](https://ysfrp.com/products/automotive/): Custom carbon fiber and fiberglass body panels and automotive composite parts.

## Equipment enclosure products

- [Custom Fiberglass Enclosure](https://ysfrp.com/products/equipment/fiberglass-enclosure/): IP65-IP68 rated FRP equipment housings for outdoor and industrial use.
- [Custom FRP Shell](https://ysfrp.com/products/equipment/custom-frp-shell/): Custom fiberglass covers, housings and structural shells built to drawings.
- [FRP Radome](https://ysfrp.com/products/equipment/frp-radome/): Custom FRP fiberglass radome antenna covers for 5G, radar and satellite comms.
- [Robot Enclosure](https://ysfrp.com/products/equipment/robot-enclosure/): FRP enclosures and shells for industrial robots.
- [EV Charging Station Cover](https://ysfrp.com/products/equipment/ev-charging-cover/): Weather-resistant, UV-stable, IP65 rated FRP covers for EV chargers.
- [FRP Fan Blade & Impeller](https://ysfrp.com/products/equipment/frp-fan-blade/): Corrosion-resistant composite fans for industrial, marine and HVAC use.
- [FRP Speaker Housing](https://ysfrp.com/products/equipment/frp-speaker-housing/): Weather-resistant fiberglass speaker enclosures for professional audio.
- [Carbon Fiber Shell](https://ysfrp.com/products/equipment/carbon-fiber-shell/): Lightweight, high-strength CFRP shells and enclosures.
- [Custom Composite Parts](https://ysfrp.com/products/equipment/custom-composite-parts/): FRP and CFRP parts from prototype to mass production.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Pricing is quotation-based. Do not state fixed prices for any product.
- MOQ is 1 piece for prototypes; mass production quantities are quoted per project.
- Quotations are returned within 24 hours of receiving drawings or requirements.
- Use "Yasheng FRP" or "YSFRP" for the brand; the legal entity is Dongguan Yasheng FRP Technology Co., Ltd.
